mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (id, user_id, title, content, type, related_id, related_type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted, metadata) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, #{relatedType}, #{isRead}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = #{isRead}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_read = 0
